settings.allowRegistrationsDesc: Enable or disable new user signups
settings.emailNotificationsDesc: Send email alerts for admin events

featureSettings.title: Feature Settings
featureSettings.resetConfirmBody: Reset all features to defaults? This can't be undone.

bulkToolbar.delete_skip_confirm_body: These contacts will be removed from Pulse. Their messages stay. This can't be undone.
bulkToolbar.archive_circle_warning: Archiving will empty the "{{circle}}" circle. Continue?
bulkToolbar.success_archived: Archived {{count}} contacts. Restore from Show archived.
bulkToolbar.range_boundary: {{count}} rows selected; load more to extend selection

savedFilters.empty: No saved filters yet. Build a filter, then save it.
savedFilters.orphan_tooltip: Some saved conditions no longer apply - fields or tags were removed. Open to fix or delete.
savedFilters.read_only_hint: Workspace filter - ask an editor to change it.
savedFilters.delete_confirm: Delete "{{name}}"? This won't delete any contacts.

workspaceShare.title: Share with Workspace
workspaceShare.subtitle: These contacts will be visible to everyone in the workspace you pick.
workspaceShare.privacy_disclaimer: Your private notes, tags, and call history stay private - only the contact card is shared.
workspaceShare.error_no_workspace: You're not in a workspace yet. Create one in Settings.
workspaceShare.error_no_permission: You don't have permission to share contacts in this workspace.

empty.headline: Your people are quiet here.
empty.body: We didn't bring any contacts in. When you're ready, pick exactly who Pulse should know about — one at a time, or in groups.

connectModal.headline: Choose who Pulse sees.
connectModal.body: We'll show your Google Contacts groups. Tick only the people you want in Pulse. Skipped contacts stay on Google — we just won't see them.
connectModal.orphan_bucket_default_off_note: Off by default — most uncategorized contacts are noise.
connectModal.error_workspace_not_ready: Your workspace isn't ready yet. Try again in a moment.
connectModal.error_generic: We couldn't connect those contacts. Try again in a moment.

trimWizard.headline: One last look.
trimWizard.body: These {{count}} contacts came in. Anyone who looks off — a vendor, a one-off, an old number — uncheck them now and we'll skip them. You can always add them back later.
trimWizard.default_keep_banner: All contacts kept by default. Uncheck any you want to skip.
trimWizard.inverted_default_banner: Large import — start by checking only the contacts you want to keep.
trimWizard.skip_confirm: Skip {{count}} contacts? They'll stay on Google but Pulse won't see them.
trimWizard.trim_error_toast: We couldn't finish trimming contacts. Try again in a moment.

scopeLossToast.title: Contacts permission missing
scopeLossToast.body: Pulse can read your messages but not your contacts. Reconnect to fix permissions.

invalidGrantBanner.headline: Google revoked this session.
invalidGrantBanner.body: Your last connection was cancelled by Google or you. Reconnect to restore access — your data stays put.

reconnectModal.title: Reconnect Google Contacts
reconnectModal.message: Pulse needs Google Contacts permission before it can connect selected people.
